title: Bayesian Distributionally Robust Merton Problem with Nonlinear Wasserstein Projections
abstract: arXiv:2512.01408v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We revisit Merton's continuous-time portfolio selection through a data-driven, distributionally robust lens. Our aim is to tap the benefits of frequent trading over short horizons while acknowledging that drift is hard to pin down, whereas volatility can be screened using realized or implied measures for appropriately selected assets. Rather than time-rectangular distributional robust control -- which replenishes adversarial power at every instant and induces over-pessimism -- we place a single ambiguity set on the drift prior within a Bayesian Merton model. This prior-level ambiguity preserves learning and tractability: a minimax swap reduces the robust control to optimizing a nonlinear functional of the prior, enabling Karatzas and Zhao \cite{KZ98}-type's closed-form evaluation for each candidate prior. translated_title: 贝叶斯分布鲁棒梅顿问题与非线性格 Wasserstein 投影
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.01408v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们通过数据驱动的分布鲁棒视角重新审视梅顿的连续时间投资组合选择。我们的目标是利用短时间范围内频繁交易的优势，同时承认漂移难以精确确定，而波动率可以通过适当选择资产的已实现或隐含度量进行筛选。我们不是采用时间矩形分布鲁棒控制——这种方法在每个瞬间补充对抗性力量并导致过度悲观——而是在贝叶斯梅顿模型中对漂移先验设置单一模糊集。这种先验级别的模糊性保留了学习性和可处理性：极小极大交换将鲁棒控制简化为优化先验的非线性泛函，使得对每个候选先验都能进行Karatzas和Zhao \cite{KZ98}类型的闭式评估。然后，我们通过显式的渐近最优推（pushing）方法，刻画了在Wasserstein不确定性下的小半径最坏情况先验。
tldr: 本文提出一种贝叶斯分布鲁棒梅顿方法，通过在漂移先验上设置单一模糊集而非时间矩形控制，兼顾频繁交易优势并避免过度悲观，并利用Wasserstein投影推导出小半径最坏情况先验的显式渐近最优解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian distributionally robust Merton approach that places a single ambiguity set on the drift prior rather than time-rectangular control, balancing frequent trading benefits and avoiding over-pessimism, and derives explicit asymptotically optimal worst-case priors under Wasserstein projections.
